person.name: Sung-Yong Min
person.title: Principal Engineer
person.degree: Ph.D., Materials Science and Engineering, POSTECH

profile: Process engineer with 7+ years of specialized experience in Micro LED display development at Samsung Electronics, spanning from early-stage R&D through mass production support.

Successfully developed large-area bonding techniques and pixel repair processes, contributing to the commercialization of Micro LED displays. Expertise spans the full process lifecycle — process design, materials development, quality control, and failure/defect analysis — with hands-on involvement in mass production setup and ongoing yield troubleshooting in collaboration with manufacturing teams.

Led a sub-team responsible for bonding & repair processes and served as Lab Manager overseeing process development operations. Seeking roles where deep expertise in advanced display or semiconductor packaging processes can drive meaningful impact.

Managed sub-team roadmap, process quality control, and member development as sub-team lead
